csi_deployment.publisher_service:
[Unit]
Description=Agent Computer trusted Candidate CSI publisher
After=ac-k3s.service
Requires=ac-k3s.service
Wants=agent-computer-csi-registrar.service

[Service]
Type=simple
User=root
Group=root
# Set NODE_NAME to the exact Kubernetes node name in this operator-owned file.
EnvironmentFile=/etc/agent-computer/csi.env
ExecStartPre=/usr/bin/install -d -m 0700 /var/lib/agent-computer-csi
ExecStartPre=/usr/bin/install -d -m 0755 /var/lib/kubelet/plugins/csi.agent-computer.io /var/lib/kubelet/plugins_registry
ExecStart=/usr/local/bin/agent-computer-csi ${NODE_NAME}
Restart=on-failure
RestartSec=2
UMask=0077
NoNewPrivileges=true
PrivateMounts=no
# Do not add filesystem sandbox directives creating a separate mount namespace:
# publication must be visible to Kubelet and the local execution controller.
RestrictAddressFamilies=AF_UNIX
LimitNOFILE=8192

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target
csi_deployment.registrar_service:
[Unit]
Description=Agent Computer CSI registration using upstream node-driver-registrar
After=agent-computer-csi.service
Requires=agent-computer-csi.service
PartOf=agent-computer-csi.service

[Service]
Type=simple
User=root
Group=root
# Install an operator-verified upstream registrar; the component evidence pins
# the tested image digest and extracted executable checksum.
ExecStart=/usr/local/bin/csi-node-driver-registrar --csi-address=/var/lib/kubelet/plugins/csi.agent-computer.io/csi.sock --kubelet-registration-path=/var/lib/kubelet/plugins/csi.agent-computer.io/csi.sock --plugin-registration-path=/var/lib/kubelet/plugins_registry
Restart=on-failure
RestartSec=2
UMask=0077
NoNewPrivileges=true
RestrictAddressFamilies=AF_UNIX

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target

verified_behaviors: Original cgroup/device/inode and runtime pidfds are pinned before startup. A stopped descendant is killed; deleted original core events return ENODEV; reusing the old pathname does not redirect a kill into the replacement group.

Normal, operator-command, truncated-output and first-completion-transaction-failure cases finish Succeeded. Exit 7 and command timeout finish Failed. Explicit cancellation finishes Cancelled without claiming rollback.

Revoked authority, historical Unknown and both output-publication failures remain Unknown. Their live process/IO seals release physical writers. Later output recovery does not relabel those immutable completions.
Lost-create acknowledgement, rejected plan, controller SIGKILL, stopped PID 1 with controller loss and missing reaper retain Unknown/Draining. Recovery supplies no IO seal or startup authority.
Eleven execution completion receipts atomically accompany execution_drained records. A further bounded file edit runs in the next writer epoch; old execution recovery preserves that later lease.

Six SQL completion contracts reject binding transplants, missing verified output, incomplete transactions and commit past the original deadline; verify explicit cancellation, immutable/WAL recovery, historical epoch inputs and unresolved Unknown blocking artifacts.

A fresh read-only JuiceFS client with zero cache reads eight execution files and the next writer file; cancelled/revoked delayed writes are absent. Independent signed Python S3 reads verify 32 object references.
Fourteen CSI claims are revoked; exact retry/restart preserves active identity, revoked/replaced/foreign mounts are rejected, foreign cleanup targets are retained, and an unprivileged peer is denied.
experiment_notes: No registered repo-sandbox target was available. An owned QEMU VM used Linux 6.8, 4 vCPU, 6 GiB RAM and a disposable 24 GiB overlay; the overlay, private SSH keys and cloud-init data were removed after independent collection.

An initial removal probe rejected completion because kernfs retains directory st_nlink=2 after rmdir. The implementation now recognizes ENODEV only on its previously validated pinned core cgroup.events FD, with independent original pidfd exit checks and the live IO barrier. The removal/path-reuse probe passed on the final code.

The first execution attempt exposed the old recovery query depending on the mutable current lease epoch after a successful new writer. The final code reads immutable epoch history; SQL regression and the complete 16-case rerun passed.
One earlier test organization with a successful execution and next-epoch file edit remains outside final-run counts. Collection scopes all SQL and Pod observations to the final organization.

Bazel lock regeneration copied only public local Cargo registry caches into its isolated cache. The final lock diff contains the node manifest input and rustix event feature, without dependency version changes.
limits: Single qualified Linux/K3s/containerd/gVisor/JuiceFS/S3 VM. Computer ready remains false, public execution unsupported and T01-T43 not_run.
Pinned core ENODEV behavior is kernel-specific qualification, not general path absence, arbitrary read failure or a filesystem IO receipt.
Controller loss, unresolved in-flight IO, multi-node fencing, power-loss recovery and arbitrary App checkpointing are not solved by serialized completion metadata.
The Candidate barrier excludes trusted direct backing writers and legacy direct mounts. Node identities, storage qualification and operator deployment remain required.
The VM uses isolated HTTP S3 transport. It is not production TLS, HA or cross-node qualification.
Registry tombstones and completed records remain retained; automatic reclamation is not implemented.
